from pathlib import Path
import re
p = Path('src/data/lyrics/zuljana-hai-kahan.md')
key = b'romanLyrics: |-\\n'
sep = b'\\n---\\n'
header, rest = p.read_bytes().split(key, 1)
old, body = rest.split(sep, 1)
words = dict(zip(
    'shabbir zuljana zuljanah sakina baage khali nahi zabaṅ kahaṅ kahan mai paungi chor tamachoṅ bachayega sulayega sayebaṅ tarha sahare rawaṅ chalane layiṅ pani zibha dahaṅ khadar barchiyaṅ jayega jahaṅ wahaṅ Haye farhan mazhar masum siskiyaṅ'.split(),
    'Shabbir Zuljanaah Zuljanaah Sakina baageṅ khaali nahiṅ zabaaṅ kahaaṅ kahaaṅ main paauṅ~gi chhor tamaanchoṅ bachaayega sulaayega saayebaaṅ tarah sahaare rawaaṅ chalaane laeeṅ paani zabh dahaaṅ qadar barchhiyaaṅ jaayega jahaaṅ wahaaṅ Haaye Farhan Mazhar maasum siskiyaaṅ'.split(), strict=True))
lines = []
for line in old.decode().splitlines():
    line = re.sub(r'[A-Za-zṅ]+', lambda m: words.get(m[0].lower(), words.get(m[0], m[0])), line)
    line = line.replace('~', ' ').replace('aansu ', 'aansuṅ ').replace('dam e zabh', 'dam-e-zabh').replace('Dard e furqat', 'Dard-e-furqat')
    lines.append(line)
source = body.decode().strip().splitlines()
assert len(lines) == len(source)
assert lines[0].strip() == '1' and source[0] == '۱'
for line, verse in zip(lines, source):
    assert all(c.isascii() or c in 'ṅṄ' for c in line)
    assert line.count('ṅ') + line.split().count('main') == verse.count('ں'), (line, verse)
p.write_bytes(header + key + '\\n'.join(lines).encode() + sep + body)
assert p.read_bytes().split(key, 1)[0] == header
assert p.read_bytes().split(sep, 1)[1] == body
print('\\n'.join(lines))
